microscopic_law.heavy: EM-neutral SU4 fundamental, whole H=-Lambda*h_light, same bare m/r/v/improved and same frame, independently occupied lowest two levels.
microscopic_law.light: Endpoint-averaged primitive scalar_paths with positive light whole h.
microscopic_law.sea_energy_identity: Integrated Tr h=0, hence Eheavy=Lambda*Elight and combined half-sea energy=(Lambda+1)*Elight. Individual non-Abelian h(p,U) need not be traceless.
microscopic_law.uniform_links: Ui=exp(i*g*sum_a theta_i,a Ta); an actual axis path of length l uses ordered Ui^l.

balanced_mean_constraint.meaning: Complementary unprojected opposite-band Slater seas cancel local mean traceless colour. Local colour fluctuates: this is a balanced mean constraint, not a Gauss eigenstate or quantum SU4 vacuum.

coupling_unit_control.method: Rebuild derivatives at a second g; enforce g^2-normalized sea/bare matrices and the raw generalized spectrum, not merely clipped thresholds.

direction_selection.rule: Two dense noncommuting fixed trigonometric candidates; first maximizes min(|contact|,|pair|) before any FD is evaluated.

explicit_safe_scalar_hypothesis.interpretation: An externally chosen scalar J>Jcritical, not dynamically selected and not a finite-q/nonlinear/quantum stability certificate.

selected_saddle_certificate.interpretation: Common balanced shape selected by the reused unrestricted Gram saddle. Heavy microscopic law here is the whole negative -Lambda h, not the original same-sign sea occupation.

threshold.scope: Necessary and sufficient positive-definiteness threshold of this 45D static q=0 Hessian; strict J>Jcritical is sufficient, not a phase theorem.
